sources.finding: Fed held its target range; inflation remained elevated. Contemporary macro context, not measured video demand.
February CPI release preceded the March inflation explainer. A scheduled official statistical release, not search-interest measurement.
March CPI release occurred AFTER the April 9 Short; cannot explain publication-day knowledge. It preceded the April 18 follow-up.
Reciprocal-tariff order is dated April 2; full page retrieved on retry. Contemporary policy event, not video demand evidence.
US-China joint statement announced tariff changes; date only. Intraday availability relative to the 07:50 UTC Short is unverified. Later than May 7/8 uploads.
SEC announced a June 9 DeFi roundtable on May 28. Regulatory context preceded May 31 and June Shorts; no evidence it drove their views.
September archive checked. Pre-upload disaster-preparedness notice does not establish demand for general tax definitions; later notices excluded from publication-time explanations.
May EIA release described ongoing Mideast disruption and an assumed late-May Hormuz closure. Predates May 26 oil upload; source forecast, not certainty.
July EIA release described resumed Hormuz traffic and forecast recovery. Predates July 10 recession upload; broad energy-shock context, not proof of recession.

Company announced fiscal Q1 results before the July 9 video; commercial AI infrastructure context, 50 days distant. Does not verify video demand, founder dialogue or historical valuation claims. Later Q2 results excluded.
EIA contemporaneous forecast identified Hormuz closure/production outages. Predates April 30 petrodollar upload; oil context only, not proof of currency demand or geopolitical causation.

Staff research describes multiple institutional, financial-market and network foundations for dollar use. Research interpretation, not proof oil alone causes reserve dominance. Available before the video.

IMF analysis distinguishes exchange-rate valuation effects from actual reserve portfolio changes. A declining dollar share does not by itself establish active dollar selling. Available before April 2026 upload.

Search-result aggregator reports a Massie bill on Epstein-file release and, separately, a House Oversight records release dated July 27-28 (AFTER the July 21 upload; excluded). Primary congressional pages not retrieved; day-level pre-upload salience unverified.

Secondary reports place gold's first $5,000+ prints and record highs in late January 2026, shortly before the Jan 31 upload; magnitudes differ by source and no primary exchange/LBMA page was retrieved.

Capital Group analysis (chart dated Oct 20, 2025) compares the AI-era Nasdaq-100 with 1997-2000 and argues it looks more like 1998 than 2000; evidences contemporary public AI-vs-dotcom framing before Oct 27 and Dec 12, 2025 uploads, not video demand.

Palantir Q4 2025 results were released Feb 2, 2026, AFTER the Jan 10 upload; search coverage also reports a January share-price decline. Excluded as a publication-time cause; no pre-upload Palantir trigger verified.

Energy trade press 'Oil Prices, Apr. 1, 2026' and search coverage report early-April crude near $110 with Strait of Hormuz disruption, a ceasefire around April 8 and late-April volatility; precedes the April 19 upload. Figures vary by source and were not verified against a primary exchange or EIA release.

Fortune headline and AP-sourced coverage report Bitcoin passing $118,000 to a record on July 11, 2025, one day before the July 12 upload; Senate-passed GENIUS Act stablecoin bill was pending in the House. GENIUS signing in the following week post-dates the upload and is excluded. Price values from search snippets, not primary exchange data.

Low-quality aggregator and blog results state a SpaceX IPO around June 11-12, 2026 and Musk trillionaire status; sources conflict on price ($135 vs $150) and valuation. Forbes/Bloomberg pages were not retrieved. Date order is plausible (two months before the Aug 11 upload) but the event is UNVERIFIED.

Washington Times headline (Feb 3, 2026) 'Xi continues purge of China's military'; other results report January 2026 removals of senior generals, Xi's Feb 11 public acknowledgment (after the Feb 10 upload) and Feb 25-26 NPC actions (after). Headline-level evidence only.
Trade-press report of Tesla Q3 deliveries and BYD BEV sales published after the Sept 9, 2026 upload; excluded as a publication-time explanation. No verified pre-upload BYD-vs-Tesla trigger was found.

google_trends.interpretation: No demand trend inferred. Any future series is normalized 0–100 relative interest, not absolute volume.
